arxiv-2002-07702.title: NGC 6397: The metallicity trend along the isochrone revisited
arxiv-2002-07702.creator: Rashi Jain, Philippe Prugniel, Lucimara Martins, Ariane Lançon
arxiv-2002-07702.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Rashi Jain, Philippe Prugniel, Lucimara Martins, Ariane Lançon. Recent work has used spectra of ∼ \sim 5000 stars in NGC 6397 that were extracted from a MUSE mosaic to determine the atmospheric parameters for these stars by fitting the spectra against the Göttingen Spectral Library. A significant change in metallicity between the turn off and the red giant branch was found and was discussed as a possible manifestation of predicted effects of atomic diffusion.

arxiv-2110-10557.title: Analytic Correlation of Inflationary Potential to Power Spectrum Shape: Limits of Validity, and ‘No-Go’ for Small Field Model Analytics
arxiv-2110-10557.creator: Ira Wolfson
arxiv-2110-10557.description: Abstract The primordial power spectrum informs the possible inflationary histories of our universe. Given a power spectrum, the ensuing cosmic microwave background is calculated and compared to the observed one. Thus, one focus of modern cosmology is building well-motivated inflationary models that predict the primordial power spectrum observables.

arxiv-2201-13306.title: Deep learning for disordered topological insulators through entanglement spectrum
arxiv-2201-13306.creator: Alejandro José Uría-Álvarez, Daniel Molpeceres-Mingo, Juan José Palacios
arxiv-2201-13306.description: Abstract Calculation of topological invariants for crystalline systems is well understood in reciprocal space, allowing for the topological classification of a wide spectrum of materials. In this work, we present a technique based on the entanglement spectrum, which can be used to identify the hidden topology of systems without translational invariance.

arxiv-2205-15465.title: Analyzing Modality Robustness in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2205-15465.creator: Devamanyu Hazarika, Yingting Li, Bo Cheng, Shuai Zhao, Roger Zimmermann, Soujanya Poria
arxiv-2205-15465.description: Abstract Building robust multimodal models are crucial for achieving reliable deployment in the wild. Despite its importance, less attention has been paid to identifying and improving the robustness of Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) models. In this work, we hope to address that by ( i i ) Proposing simple diagnostic checks for modality robustness in a trained multimodal model.

arxiv-2212-08799.title: Qudit entanglers using quantum optimal control
arxiv-2212-08799.creator: Sivaprasad Omanakuttan, Anupam Mitra, Eric J. Meier, Michael J. Martin, Ivan H Deutsch
arxiv-2212-08799.description: Abstract We study the generation of two-qudit entangling quantum logic gates using two techniques in quantum optimal control. We take advantage of both continuous, Lie algebraic control and digital, Lie group control. In both cases, the key is access to a time-dependent Hamiltonian which can generate an arbitrary unitary matrix in the group SU( d 2 d^{2} ).

arxiv-2305-13273.title: Robust excitation of C-band quantum dots for quantum communication
arxiv-2305-13273.creator: Michal Vyvlecka, Lennart Jehle, Cornelius Nawrath, Francesco Giorgino, Mathieu Bozzio, Robert Sittig, Michael Jetter, Simone L. Portalupi, Peter Michler, Philip Walther
arxiv-2305-13273.description: Abstract Building a quantum internet requires efficient and reliable quantum hardware, from photonic sources to quantum repeaters and detectors, ideally operating at telecommunication wavelengths. Thanks to their high brightness and single-photon purity, quantum dot (QD) sources hold the promise to achieve high communication rates for quantum-secured network applications.

arxiv-2306-07143.title: Measurement of the scaling slope of compressible magnetohydrodynamic turbulence by synchrotron radiation statistics 2023 Measurement of the scaling slope of compressible magnetohydrodynamic turbulence by synchrotron radiation statistics –
arxiv-2306-07143.creator: Xue-Wen Zhang, Jian-Fu Zhang, Ru-Yue Wang, Fu-Yuan Xiang
arxiv-2306-07143.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xue-Wen Zhang, Jian-Fu Zhang, Ru-Yue Wang, Fu-Yuan Xiang. Based on magnetohydrodynamic turbulence simulations, we generate synthetic synchrotron observations to explore the scaling slope of the underlying MHD turbulence. We propose the new Q Q - U U cross intensity X X and cross-correlation intensity Y Y to measure the spectral properties of magnetic turbulence, together with statistics of the traditional synchrotron I I and polarization P ​ I PI intensities.

arxiv-2401-07789.title: Radial Oscillations of Hybrid Stars and Neutron Stars including Delta baryons: The Effect of a Slow Quark Phase Transition
arxiv-2401-07789.creator: and Ilídio Lopes
arxiv-2401-07789.description: Abstract We study radial oscillations of hybrid neutron stars composed of hadronic external layers followed by a quark matter core. We employ a density-dependent relativistic mean-field model including hyperons and Δ {\Delta} baryons to describe hadronic matter, and a density-dependent quark model for quark matter.

arxiv-2504-02768.title: MultiBLiMP 1.0: A Massively Multilingual Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs
arxiv-2504-02768.creator: Jaap Jumelet, Leonie Weissweiler, Joakim Nivre, Arianna Bisazza
arxiv-2504-02768.description: Abstract We introduce MultiBLiMP 1.0, a massively multilingual benchmark of linguistic minimal pairs, covering 101 languages and 2 types of subject-verb agreement, containing more than 128,000 minimal pairs. Our minimal pairs are created using a fully automated pipeline, leveraging the large-scale linguistic resources of Universal Dependencies and UniMorph. MultiBLiMP 1.

arxiv-2507-18496.title: Constant mean curvature Radial graphs over domains of 𝕊 n \mathbb{S}^{n} Thanks: Research partially supported by FUNCAP Grant No. BP6-00241-00347.01.00/25
arxiv-2507-18496.creator: Flávio Cruz, José T. Cruz and Jocel Oliveira
arxiv-2507-18496.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Flávio Cruz, José T. Cruz and Jocel Oliveira. We establish the existence of hypersurfaces with constant mean curvature and a prescribed boundary in Euclidean space, represented as radial graphs over domains of the unit sphere. Under the assumptions that the mean curvature of the domain’s boundary is positive and that a subsolution exists for the associated Dirichlet problem, we extend Serrin’s classical result to include the case of positive constant mean curvature. 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2512-23643.title: Simultaneous Approximation of the Score Function and Its Derivatives by Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-2512-23643.creator: Konstantin Yakovlev, Nikita Puchkin
arxiv-2512-23643.description: Abstract We present a theory for simultaneous approximation of the score function and its derivatives, enabling the handling of data distributions with low-dimensional structure and unbounded support. Our approximation error bounds match those in the literature while relying on assumptions that relax the usual bounded support requirement. Crucially, our bounds are free from the curse of dimensionality.

arxiv-2601-12752.title: SoundPlot: An Open-Source Framework for Birdsong Acoustic Analysis and Neural Synthesis with Interactive 3D Visualization
arxiv-2601-12752.creator: Naqcho Ali Mehdi, Mohammad Adeel, Aizaz Ali Larik
arxiv-2601-12752.description: Abstract We present SoundPlot, an open-source framework for analyzing avian vocalizations through acoustic feature extraction, dimensionality reduction, and neural audio synthesis. The system transforms audio signals into a multi-dimensional acoustic feature space, enabling real-time visualization of temporal dynamics in 3D using web-based interactive graphics.

pmc-11516964.title: How to measure the general Environmental Health Literacy
pmc-11516964.creator: S Lopez Lumbi, L Masciangelo, M Liebig-Gonglach, A Duda, J Rodenkirchen, A Hoyer, C Hornberg, T Mc Call
pmc-11516964.description: BackgroundMany environmental factors, both natural or man-made, are associated with health risks. To make informed decisions about these potential risks, certain skills and competencies are necessary. The concept of Environmental Health Literacy (EHL) which integrates aspects of Science Literacy, Health Literacy and Environmental Literacy encompasse these competencies.

pmc-12429092.title: Molecular Underpinning of Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia: A Putative Different Neurobiology from Treatment-Responsive Schizophrenia
pmc-12429092.creator: Annarita Barone, Licia Vellucci, Mariateresa Ciccarelli, Marta Matrone, Giuseppe De Simone, Federica Iannotta, Felice Iasevoli, Andrea de Bartolomeis, Efthimios M C Skoulakis
pmc-12429092.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Treatment-resistant schizophrenia (TRS) affects up to one in three individuals with schizophrenia and is associated with a significant clinical, social, and economic burden. Different from treatment-responsive forms, TRS appears to involve other biological mechanisms extending beyond dopaminergic dysfunctions. This review outlines current knowledge on the molecular and cellular basis of TRS, focusing on alterations in glutamate signaling, imbalances between excitatory and inhibitory activity, disruptions in D-amino acid metabolism, and evidence of neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, and mitochondrial or endoplasmic reticulum dysfunction.

pmc-12540212.title: Comparing loss of individual fragile X proteins suggests strong links to cellular senescence and aging
pmc-12540212.creator: Sonja Menge, Inmaculada Segura, Max Hartmann, Lorena Decker, Selin Kiran, Karin M Danzer, Sebastian Iben, Angelika B Harbauer, Patrick Oeckl, Axel Freischmidt
pmc-12540212.description: Members of the fragile X protein (FXP) family (FMR1, FXR1 and FXR2) are differentially expressed in most types of cancer and major neurodegenerative diseases. While increased expression of FXR1 in cancer has been linked to senescence evasion and consequently tumor initiation and progression, decreased expression of FXPs in neurodegeneration may contribute to pathogenic protein aggregation and death of vulnerable neurons.

pmc-12547460.title: Comprehensive review of understanding ancient dietary habits using modern analytical techniques
pmc-12547460.creator: Nehal S Ramadan, Magdy M El-Sayed, Hesham Sameh Ramadan, Mostafa Ismail, Heba Abdelmegeed, Nashwa Gaber, Mahmoud M Sakr
pmc-12547460.description: Understanding ancient dietary habits is essential for reconstructing ancient lifestyles. Archaeobotanical and archaeological remains, such as seeds, plant fibers, and pottery, serve as vital indicators of agriculture and daily life. We proposed that contemporary biomolecular and analytical methods provide unique insights into dietary habits through these artifacts.

pmc-12626868.title: Differential impact of overt and subclinical hypothyroidism on severe postpartum hemorrhage: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12626868.creator: Jungou Zhuang, Qiaoli Guo, Chenning Liu, Yujiao Fu, Yuhui Liu, Li Tang, Fang He
pmc-12626868.description: BackgroundThe impact of hypothyroidism, which can be divided into overt hypothyroidism and subclinical hypothyroidism, on severe postpartum hemorrhage (SPPH) remains unknown.MethodsA total of 34,303 pregnant women from the Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University between 2016 and 2020 were included in this retrospective cohort study.

pmc-12659299.title: High serum isthmin-1 as a biomarker for the progression of renal function decline in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
pmc-12659299.creator: Chuan Wang, Yifei Cheng, Mingyue Xu, Li Chen, Jinbo Liu
pmc-12659299.description: ObjectivesTo determine the relationship between serum Ism-1 levels and the progression of renal function decline in patients with T2DM.MethodsThis prospective longitudinal study included 223 patients with T2DM. Patients were divided into quartiles according to serum Ism-1 levels. A Cox proportional hazards ratio model was applied to analyze the relationship between CKD progression and serum Ism-1 levels.

pmc-12983217.title: Beyond CAR-T and oncology: broadening chimeric antigen receptor technologies across cell types and diseases
pmc-12983217.creator: Xiaohong Liu, Hongye Gao, Jianhua Yu
pmc-12983217.description: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-engineered immune cells have revolutionized cancer immunotherapy, expanding from the established success of CAR-T cells to a diverse array of cellular platforms. While seven Food and Drug Administration-approved CAR-T cell products demonstrate unprecedented efficacy in hematologic malignancies, significant limitations persist, including severe inflammatory toxicities, resistance in solid tumors, and manufacturing barriers.

pmc-13085608.title: A case of uveitis and retinal vasculitis induced by varicella-zoster virus: vitrectomy treatment and literature review
pmc-13085608.creator: Jingjing Tian, Yuze Jiang, Nannan Ye, Yankun Zhang
pmc-13085608.description: BackgroundInfectious uveitis can be induced by a variety of factors, including viral, bacterial, and parasitic infections, among others. Among these, viral infections are the most common cause of infectious uveitis. Traditional diagnostic methods have limited sensitivity and are often cumbersome, which restricts their ability to accurately identify the viral pathogens responsible.

pmc-13098097.title: Inferior Vena Cava Thrombosis After Nephrectomy of the Native Kidneys in Patients With Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease
pmc-13098097.creator: Yuto Matsushita, Kyohei Watanabe, Taro Aoki, Hajime Tsuyuki, Hiromitsu Watanabe, Keita Tamura, Kazuto Katahashi, Shinsuke Isobe, Daisuke Motoyama, Teruo Inamoto
pmc-13098097.description: BackgroundInferior vena cava (IVC) thrombosis associated with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD), caused by mechanical compression from a large liver or renal cysts, has previously been reported. However, postoperative thrombosis following nephrectomy of the native kidneys has not been described.Case PresentationCase 1A 50‐year‐old female underwent bilateral native nephrectomy to create space for a kidney allograft.

pmc-13169836.title: Hepatitis C self-testing and self-collection among people with experience in the Canadian carceral system: a qualitative study
pmc-13169836.creator: Tamara Barnett, Kody Muncaster, Olivia Gemma, Chance Cordon, Andrew B. Mendlowitz, Guillaume Fontaine, Karen A. Campbell, Mia. J. Biondi
pmc-13169836.description: BackgroundThe World Health Organization (WHO) has identified hepatitis C virus (HCV) self-testing as a priority to achieve global HCV elimination goals. However, clinical utility and acceptability of HCV self-testing remain limited, especially among individuals with experience of incarceration, a population disproportionally impacted by HCV.

pmc-13234471.title: Live-cell Pick-Seq (LiP-Seq): Interrogating ultra-rare mantle cell lymphoma persistent cells after CART19 therapy
pmc-13234471.creator: Ran Xu, Gongwei Wu, Siobhan Rice, Matthew Booker, Jenalyn Weekes, Hayden Bell, Yifei Gao, Ajit J Nirmal, Huiyun Liu, Zoe Ciantra, Qingyu Luo, Amanda Fortune, Karley Whalen, Timothy Guanci, Yifei Wan, Abner Louissaint, Joshua J Nordberg, Jia-Ren Lin, Michael Hemann, Scott R Manalis, Philippe Armand,

Key Points•LiP-Seq is a novel platform to capture single, viable, and ultrarare persistent lymphoma cells for single-cell sequencing.•LiP-Seq analysis of persistent MCL cells revealed upregulated IFITM2, which confers relative protection from CAR-T killing in vitro.

In Pseudomonas aeruginosa, however, the molecular basis of cysteine production has only recently begun to emerge. Here, we identify PA3816 as the major P.

pmc-13349050.title: The abnormal C-terminus caused by DVL1 variants impacts Robinow syndrome phenotypes
pmc-13349050.creator: Shruti S Tophkhane, Gamze Akarsu, Sarah J Gignac, Xinyi Xie, Katherine Fu, Esther M Verheyen, Joy M Richman
pmc-13349050.description: Robinow Syndrome is a genetically heterogeneous, rare skeletal disorder characterized by craniofacial and limb defects. All 7 causative genes lie in the Wingless-related Integration site-1 (WNT) pathway. Here we study the pathogenesis of DVL1 (Dishevelled 1), the most commonly affected gene, where variants cause a frameshift that replaces the C terminus with a novel peptide.

pmc-13532335.creator: You-you Li, Hai Zhang, Li-na Shao, Bao-ling Liu, Yuan-meng Wang, Jia-qi Duan, Si-Yuan Lai, Zhi-wen Xu, Ling Zhu
pmc-13532335.description: Rapid, sensitive, and RADIANT-deployable nucleic acid diagnostics are essential for the prevention and control of porcine adenovirus type 3 (PAdV-3). pmc-13553293.description: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic inflammatory disease of the central nervous system characterized by demyelination disseminated in space and time. Here we performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) using 688 MS cases and 205,199 controls from the Japanese population and identified significant associations in the major histocompatibility complex region and a population-specific risk variant in 11q24.
